description: Prorate a money amount across a date range, in exact cents. The window is half-open: from the start date up to but not including the end date. The charge is amount × days used / days in the period, rounded half away from zero. The used range has to sit inside the period. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prorate
